name: print-social-boutique-residence-post-with-two-frosted-panels-at-dusk
title: Lit apartment complex at dusk with a top title panel and bottom price panel in frosted glass
whatItIs: A portrait photo of a beige apartment complex with glowing windows over a hillside city at dusk, a frosted glass panel at the top with 'CANAL TERRACE' and 'A boutique-style residence', and a lower-left panel with price per square metre and city.
whatItMeans: Warm and aspirational; glass panels let the glowing windows lead.
techniques: Place a frosted title panel at the top.
Add a small price panel at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: The twilight period with deep blue light.
A blurred translucent box holding text.
A bold name and a light descriptor.
A short line stating cost and place.
